name: InTraveler VR
summary:
InTraveler VR is a story-driven adventure game set in mind-bending worlds inside the minds of people suffering from mental weaknesses. Experiencing a new dimension of worlds from their perspectives, solving intriguing puzzles as you traverse their story.

Guided by an InTraveler, detective Milo, to travel through Inner worlds saving those trapped inside their own worlds. Follow in Milo’s footsteps as you discover clues and secrets of each unique character, untangle the mystery of one’s mindscape.

**2 Game
